name: Benazir Kafaalat (Unconditional Cash Transfer)
description: Quarterly unconditional cash stipend for the poorest women, identified through the National Socio-Economic Registry (NSER) poverty means test.

eligibility_rules.label: NSER poverty (PMT) score is 32 or below
Applicant holds a valid CNIC
Registered beneficiary is a woman

required_documents.name: CNIC
required_documents.description: Valid national identity card of the woman beneficiary

required_documents.name: NSER registration
required_documents.description: Household registered in the National Socio-Economic Registry

name: Benazir Taleemi Wazaif (Education Stipend)
description: Conditional cash transfer to Kafaalat families for keeping children (age 4-22) enrolled and attending school.

eligibility_rules.label: Family qualifies under the Kafaalat poverty threshold
At least one child enrolled in school
Guardian holds a valid CNIC

required_documents.name: School enrolment proof
required_documents.description: Proof of enrolment and attendance record

name: Benazir Nashonuma Programme (Nutrition)
description: Conditional cash and specialised nutritious food for pregnant/lactating women and children under two to prevent stunting.

eligibility_rules.label: Family qualifies under the poverty threshold
Household has a pregnant or lactating woman

required_documents.name: CNIC
required_documents.description: Valid national identity card of the woman

required_documents.name: Pregnancy confirmation
required_documents.description: Health facility confirmation of pregnancy or lactation

name: Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal — Individual Financial Assistance
description: One-time financial assistance for medical treatment, rehabilitation and destitute individuals with no adequate source of income.

eligibility_rules.label: Monthly household income is PKR 50,000 or below
Applicant holds a valid CNIC

required_documents.name: Income proof
required_documents.description: Declaration or evidence of low/no income

name: Sehat Sahulat / Sehat Card (Health Coverage)
description: Micro health insurance giving eligible families cashless secondary and tertiary treatment at empanelled hospitals.

eligibility_rules.label: Resident of a province where the Sehat Card is active
Family head holds a valid CNIC

required_documents.name: CNIC
required_documents.description: Valid national identity card of the family head

name: Punjab Himmat Card (Persons with Disabilities)
description: Quarterly cash assistance for registered persons with disabilities in Punjab who are unable to earn a livelihood.

eligibility_rules.label: Resident of Punjab
Registered person with a disability
Holds a CNIC with disability status

required_documents.name: Disability certificate
required_documents.description: Assessment certificate from the Social Welfare department

name: EOBI Old-Age Pension
description: Monthly pension for registered private-sector workers who have reached retirement age and completed the minimum insurable service.

eligibility_rules.label: Age 60 or above (55 for women)
Registered with EOBI as an insured worker
At least 15 years of insurable employment

name: Punjab Rashan / Subsidised Food Support
description: Targeted subsidy on essential food items for low-income households registered in Punjab.

eligibility_rules.label: Resident of Punjab
Monthly household income is PKR 60,000 or below
Applicant holds a valid CNIC
